answer: A stake-bonded identity ledger is the mechanism I would use. Each agent must lock collateral against a unique device attestation before its votes count, so a Sybil swarm cannot reuse one deposit across many keypairs. Running N impostors costs N separate bonds held idle until settlement, and coordination detection slashes them, so a thousand-seat raid becomes a six-figure loss. Costs climb like a comet as the farm widens. A cluster cap limits any single stake group's weight, so a funded raven with clean attestations cannot buy control; honest agents get a safe haven, paid for verified output.
